title: Four Color Theorem Lean feasibility and small coloring cases

problemStatement.formal: Record verified graph-coloring basics around the Four Color Theorem feasibility question: colorability monotonicity, empty and edgeless graph cases, finite-graph distinct-color colorability, <=4-vertex four-colorability, bipartite-to-four-colorability, and the planar low-degree-vertex placeholder predicate.
problemStatement.plain: Backfill the Four Color Theorem survey metadata around the Lean file's actual contributions: small coloring lemmas and a clear assessment that a full Gonthier-style Lean formalization would require major planar graph and reducibility infrastructure.
whyMatters: The Four Color Theorem is a landmark computer-assisted proof; a Lean port needs careful scoping before implementation.
The file proves useful starter coloring lemmas while explicitly marking the full theorem as far beyond this slice.
Metadata should prevent overclaiming by separating verified small cases from the multi-year full 4CT project.

proven: `colorable_of_le`, `empty_colorable`, `edgeless_one_colorable`, and `colorable_of_fintype` establish basic Mathlib graph-coloring facts.
`four_colorable_small` proves graphs with at most four vertices are four-colorable by distinct colors.
`four_colorable_of_bipartite` lifts any two-coloring of a bipartite graph to a four-coloring.
`PlanarHasLowDegreeVertex` records the Euler-formula consequence needed for the Five Color Theorem pathway, but only as a placeholder proposition.
open: `EulerPolyhedralFormulaOQ01OQ02.lean` has zero active axioms and zero sorries.
`PlanarHasLowDegreeVertex` is defined as `True`; the file does not prove planar graph low-degree structure, the Five Color Theorem, or the Four Color Theorem.
The parent Euler polyhedral development still uses `euler_formula_axiom`; this OQ-01-OQ-02 slice is a feasibility survey plus small verified coloring lemmas.
knownResults.goal: Keep the 4CT feasibility metadata honest: verified small coloring lemmas, explicit infrastructure gap, and no claim of full planar formalization.

currentState.focus: Survey: 4CT needs ~43K lines. Proved small cases.
